title: The Art of Patient Relations
subtitle: Dr. Sami & Dr. Mina are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🤝

Dr. Sami is a technical and efficient dentist, but he tends to neglect the human relationship. Dr. Mina, an expert in communication and psychology, opens his eyes to the importance of empathy and listening.

Between a panicked patient, a crying child, dental phobia, or a patient with a disability, the caregiver-patient relationship is a true art.

An awkward word, a brusque gesture, and trust collapses. Attentive listening, a caring presence, and care becomes a human experience.

Patient trust, their adherence to treatment, and the serenity of the practice rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Sami is a technical dentist, but he neglects the human relationship. He discovers the basics of patient relations: empathy, active listening, anxiety management, and communication.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Sami and Dr. Mina deepen their knowledge of patients with specific needs: autism, disabilities, disorders, adapted approaches for each situation.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Sami and Dr. Mina face complex situations: advanced communication techniques, conflict management, psychological approaches. They must master the helping relationship.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Sami and Dr. Mina manage specific cases: autism, OCD, severe phobias, complex disabilities. They must adapt their approach to each human situation.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Sami and Dr. Mina become references in helping relationships. They train young dentists on the importance of empathy and communication for quality care.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice and transmission, Dr. Sami and Dr. Mina leave a legacy of humanity and kindness to the dental profession.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Sami has laid the foundations of patient relations. But the road ahead is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: Specific patients are better understood. Dr. Sami and Dr. Mina are ready for more complex cases.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Mastery of relationships is acquired. Dr. Sami and Dr. Mina have gained confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Complex cases are mastered. Dr. Sami and Dr. Mina are ready for greater challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Relational strategy has become a key skill. Dr. Sami and Dr. Mina train young dentists.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Sami and Dr. Mina have accomplished their mission. The human relationship is the heart of dental medicine.
